title: Adjunct Lecturer in Public Policy
bio: James Carras is Adjunct Lecturer in Public Policy. For over 30 years, as Principal of Carras Community Investment, Inc., he has concentrated on designing and implementing responses and solutions for equitable community and economic development opportunities. Mr. Carras is recognized nationally for the creation and expansion of over fifty development financial institutions and community investment initiatives.
research_interests: Fairness & Justice Cities & Communities Development & Economic Growth Poverty
